sentences.zh: 時有言瑞州文石可甃地者。

translations.literal: At the time someone said patterned stone from Ruizhou could pave the ground.
translations.idiomatic: At the time someone proposed that ornamental stone from Ruizhou could pave the palace ground.

sentences.zh: 太祖曰：「敦崇儉樸，猶恐習於奢華，爾乃導予奢麗乎？

translations.literal: The Founder said: "I encourage plain thrift and still fear growing used to luxury—are you leading me toward splendor?"
translations.idiomatic: The Founder said: "I promote plain thrift and still fear growing accustomed to luxury—are you leading me toward extravagance?"

sentences.zh: 」言者慚而退。

translations.literal: " The speaker withdrew in shame.
translations.idiomatic: " The speaker withdrew in shame.

sentences.zh: 洪武八年，改建大內宮殿，十年告成。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Hongwu, the great inner-palace buildings were rebuilt; in the tenth year they were completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Hongwu, the great inner-palace buildings were rebuilt; they were completed in the tenth year.

sentences.zh: 闕門曰午門，翼以兩觀。

translations.literal: The gate-tower was called Meridian Gate, flanked by two watch-towers.
translations.idiomatic: The gate-tower was called the Meridian Gate, flanked by two watch-towers.

sentences.zh: 中三門，東西為左、右掖門。

translations.literal: Three gates at the center; to east and west were the left and right side gates.
translations.idiomatic: Three gates stood at the center; to the east and west were the Left and Right Side Gates.

sentences.zh: 午門內曰奉天門，門內奉天殿，嘗禦以受朝賀者也。

translations.literal: Within Meridian Gate was Gate of Complying with Heaven; within that gate, Hall of Complying with Heaven, where the emperor had once held court to receive congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: Within the Meridian Gate was the Gate of Complying with Heaven; within that gate stood the Hall of Complying with Heaven, where the emperor had held court to receive congratulations.

sentences.zh: 門左右為東、西角門，奉天殿左、右門，左曰中左，右曰中右，兩廡之間，左曰文樓，右曰武樓。

translations.literal: To the gate's left and right were East and West Corner Gates; to the hall's left and right were gates—left called Inner Left, right Inner Right; between the two side galleries, left Literary Tower, right Martial Tower.
translations.idiomatic: To the left and right of the gate were the East and West Corner Gates; to the left and right of the hall were gates—the left called Inner Left, the right Inner Right; between the two side galleries, on the left the Literary Tower and on the right the Martial Tower.

sentences.zh: 奉天殿之後曰華蓋殿，華蓋殿之後曰謹身殿，殿後則乾清宮之正門也。

translations.literal: Behind Hall of Complying with Heaven was Hall of the Imperial Canopy; behind that, Hall of Cultivating the Person; behind the hall was the main gate of the Palace of Celestial Purity.
translations.idiomatic: Behind the Hall of Complying with Heaven was the Hall of the Imperial Canopy; behind that, the Hall of Cultivating the Person; behind the hall stood the main gate of the Palace of Celestial Purity.

sentences.zh: 奉天門外兩廡間有門，左曰左順，右曰右順。

translations.literal: Between the two side galleries outside Gate of Complying with Heaven were gates: left called Left Following Gate, right Right Following Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Between the two side galleries outside the Gate of Complying with Heaven were gates: on the left, the Left Following Gate; on the right, the Right Following Gate.

sentences.zh: 左順門外有殿曰文華，為東宮視事之所。

translations.literal: Outside Left Following Gate was a hall called Literary Splendor, the eastern palace's place for conducting affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the Left Following Gate was a hall called Literary Splendor, where the heir apparent conducted affairs.

sentences.zh: 右順門外有殿曰武英，為皇帝齋戒時所居。

translations.literal: Outside Right Following Gate was a hall called Martial Excellence, where the emperor dwelt when fasting.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the Right Following Gate was a hall called Martial Excellence, where the emperor resided when observing fasts.

sentences.zh: 制度如舊，規模益巨集。

translations.literal: The system followed the old pattern, but the scale grew even grander.
translations.idiomatic: The system followed the old pattern, but the scale grew even more imposing.

sentences.zh: 二十五年改建大內金水橋，又建端門、承天門樓各五間，及長安東、西二門。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year the great inner Golden Water Bridge was rebuilt, and Gate of the Origin and Gate of Receiving Heaven towers were each built with five bays, and the eastern and western Chang'an gates.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year the Golden Water Bridge of the great inner palace was rebuilt, and the Gate of the Origin and Gate of Receiving Heaven towers were each built with five bays, along with the eastern and western Chang'an gates.

sentences.zh: 永樂十五年，作西宮於北京。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Yongle, a western palace was built at Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Yongle, a western palace was built in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 中為奉天殿，側為左右二殿，南為奉天門，左右為東、西角門。

translations.literal: At center was Hall of Complying with Heaven, flanked by left and right halls; south was Gate of Complying with Heaven, with east and west corner gates to left and right.
translations.idiomatic: At the center stood the Hall of Complying with Heaven, flanked by left and right halls; to the south was the Gate of Complying with Heaven, with the East and West Corner Gates to left and right.

sentences.zh: 其南為午門，又南為承天門。

translations.literal: South of that was Meridian Gate, and farther south Gate of Receiving Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: South of that was the Meridian Gate, and farther south the Gate of Receiving Heaven.

sentences.zh: 殿北有後殿、涼殿、暖殿及仁壽、景福、仁和、萬春、永壽、長春等宮，凡為屋千六百三十餘楹。

translations.literal: North of the hall were rear hall, cool hall, warm hall, and palaces including Benevolent Longevity, Auspicious Fortune, Benevolence and Harmony, Myriad Springtimes, Eternal Longevity, Eternal Spring—altogether more than 1,630 bay-rooms of buildings.
translations.idiomatic: North of the hall were a rear hall, cool hall, warm hall, and palaces including Benevolent Longevity, Auspicious Fortune, Benevolence and Harmony, Myriad Springtimes, Eternal Longevity, and Eternal Spring—altogether more than 1,630 bay-rooms.

sentences.zh: 十八年，建北京，凡宮殿、門闕規制，悉如南京，壯麗過之。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, Beijing was built; palace buildings and gate-towers all followed Nanjing's regulations, surpassing it in magnificence.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, Beijing was built; the regulations for palace buildings and gate-towers all followed Nanjing, but surpassed it in magnificence.

sentences.zh: 中朝曰奉天殿，通為屋八千三百五十楹。

translations.literal: The central court was called Hall of Complying with Heaven, altogether 8,350 bay-rooms of buildings.
translations.idiomatic: The central court was called the Hall of Complying with Heaven, comprising altogether 8,350 bay-rooms.

sentences.zh: 殿左曰中左門，右曰中右門。

translations.literal: To the hall's left was Inner Left Gate, to the right Inner Right Gate.
translations.idiomatic: To the left of the hall was the Inner Left Gate; to the right, the Inner Right Gate.

sentences.zh: 丹墀東曰文樓，西曰武樓，南曰奉天門，常朝所禦也。

translations.literal: East of the red steps was Literary Tower, west Martial Tower, south Gate of Complying with Heaven—the gates where regular court was held.
translations.idiomatic: East of the red steps was the Literary Tower; west, the Martial Tower; south, the Gate of Complying with Heaven—where the emperor held regular court.

sentences.zh: 左曰東角門，右曰西角門，東廡曰左順門，西廡曰右順門，正南曰午門。

translations.literal: To the left East Corner Gate, to the right West Corner Gate; east gallery Left Following Gate, west gallery Right Following Gate; due south Meridian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: To the left, the East Corner Gate; to the right, the West Corner Gate; the east gallery, the Left Following Gate; the west gallery, the Right Following Gate; due south, the Meridian Gate.

sentences.zh: 中三門，翼以兩觀，觀各有樓，左曰左掖門，右曰右掖門。

translations.literal: Three gates at the center, flanked by two watch-towers; each tower had a pavilion—left called Left Side Gate, right Right Side Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Three gates stood at the center, flanked by two watch-towers; each tower had a gate pavilion—the left called the Left Side Gate, the right the Right Side Gate.

sentences.zh: 午門左稍南，曰闕左門，曰神廚門，內為太廟。

translations.literal: Slightly south of Meridian Gate on the left: Gate Left of the Tower, Spirit Kitchen Gate; within lay the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Slightly south of the Meridian Gate on the left were the Gate Left of the Tower and the Spirit Kitchen Gate; within lay the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 右稍南，曰闕右門，曰社左門，內為太社稷。

translations.literal: Slightly south on the right: Gate Right of the Tower, Spirit Altar Left Gate; within lay the Imperial Altars of Soil and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: Slightly south on the right were the Gate Right of the Tower and the Spirit Altar Left Gate; within lay the Imperial Altars of Soil and Grain.

sentences.zh: 又正南曰端門，東曰廟街門，即太廟右門也。

translations.literal: Farther due south, Gate of the Origin; east, Temple Street Gate—the right gate of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south stood the Gate of the Origin; to the east, the Temple Street Gate—the right gate of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 西曰社街門，即太社稷壇南左門也。

translations.literal: West, Altar Street Gate—the southern left gate of the Imperial Altars of Soil and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: To the west, the Altar Street Gate—the southern left gate of the Imperial Altars of Soil and Grain.

sentences.zh: 又正南曰承天門，又折而東曰長安左門，折而西曰長安右門。

translations.literal: Still farther south, Gate of Receiving Heaven; then bending east, Chang'an Left Gate; bending west, Chang'an Right Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Still farther south stood the Gate of Receiving Heaven; then bending east, the Chang'an Left Gate; bending west, the Chang'an Right Gate.

sentences.zh: 東後曰東安門，西後曰西安門，北後曰北安門。

translations.literal: Behind on the east, East Peace Gate; behind on the west, West Peace Gate; behind on the north, North Peace Gate.
translations.idiomatic: To the rear on the east, the East Peace Gate; to the rear on the west, the West Peace Gate; to the rear on the north, the North Peace Gate.

sentences.zh: 正南曰大明門，中為馳道，東西長廊各千步。

translations.literal: Due south, Great Ming Gate; at center a imperial roadway; east and west long corridors each a thousand paces.
translations.idiomatic: Due south stood the Great Ming Gate; at the center ran the imperial roadway; the east and west long corridors each extended a thousand paces.

sentences.zh: 奉天殿之後曰華蓋殿，又後曰謹身殿。

translations.literal: Behind Hall of Complying with Heaven was Hall of the Imperial Canopy, and behind that Hall of Cultivating the Person.
translations.idiomatic: Behind the Hall of Complying with Heaven was the Hall of the Imperial Canopy, and behind that the Hall of Cultivating the Person.

sentences.zh: 謹身殿左曰後左門，右曰後右門。

translations.literal: Left of Hall of Cultivating the Person was Rear Left Gate, right Rear Right Gate.
translations.idiomatic: To the left of the Hall of Cultivating the Person was the Rear Left Gate; to the right, the Rear Right Gate.

sentences.zh: 正北曰乾清門，內為乾清宮，是曰正寢。

translations.literal: Due north, Gate of Celestial Purity; within was Palace of Celestial Purity—the principal sleeping quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Due north stood the Gate of Celestial Purity; within was the Palace of Celestial Purity—the principal sleeping quarters.

sentences.zh: 後曰交泰殿。

translations.literal: Behind was Hall of Union of Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: Behind it stood the Hall of Union of Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 又後曰坤甯宮，為中宮所居。

translations.literal: Farther behind was Palace of Earthly Tranquility, where the empress dwelt.
translations.idiomatic: Farther behind was the Palace of Earthly Tranquility, where the empress resided.

sentences.zh: 東曰仁壽宮，西曰清甯宮，以奉太后。

translations.literal: East, Palace of Benevolent Longevity; west, Palace of Pure Tranquility—for receiving the empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: To the east, the Palace of Benevolent Longevity; to the west, the Palace of Pure Tranquility—for lodging the empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 左順門之東曰文華殿。

translations.literal: East of Left Following Gate was Literary Splendor Hall.
translations.idiomatic: East of the Left Following Gate was the Literary Splendor Hall.

sentences.zh: 右順門之西曰武英殿。

translations.literal: West of Right Following Gate was Martial Excellence Hall.
translations.idiomatic: West of the Right Following Gate was the Martial Excellence Hall.

sentences.zh: 文華殿東南曰東華門，武英殿西南曰西華門。

translations.literal: Southeast of Literary Splendor Hall was East Flowery Gate; southwest of Martial Excellence Hall was West Flowery Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast of the Literary Splendor Hall was the East Flowery Gate; southwest of the Martial Excellence Hall was the West Flowery Gate.

sentences.zh: 坤甯宮後曰坤寧門，門之後曰玄武門。

translations.literal: Behind Palace of Earthly Tranquility was Gate of Earthly Tranquility; behind the gate, North Mystical Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Behind the Palace of Earthly Tranquility was the Gate of Earthly Tranquility; behind the gate stood the North Mystical Gate.

sentences.zh: 其他宮殿，名號繁多，不能盡列，所謂千門萬戶也。

translations.literal: Other palaces were too numerous in name to list in full—what people call a thousand gates and ten thousand doors.
translations.idiomatic: The other palaces were too numerous in name to list in full—what people call "a thousand gates and ten thousand doors."

sentences.zh: 皇城內宮城外，凡十有二門：曰東上門、東上北門、東上南門、東中門、西上門、西上北門、西上南門、西中門、北上門、北上東門、北上西門、北中門。

translations.literal: Outside the inner-palace city wall within the Imperial City, there were twelve gates in all: East Upper Gate, East Upper North Gate, East Upper South Gate, East Central Gate, West Upper Gate, West Upper North Gate, West Upper South Gate, West Central Gate, North Upper Gate, North Upper East Gate, North Upper West Gate, North Central Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the inner-palace city wall but within the Imperial City there were twelve gates in all: the East Upper Gate, East Upper North Gate, East Upper South Gate, East Central Gate, West Upper Gate, West Upper North Gate, West Upper South Gate, West Central Gate, North Upper Gate, North Upper East Gate, North Upper West Gate, and North Central Gate.

sentences.zh: 復於皇城東南建皇太孫宮，東安門外東南建十王街。

translations.literal: Again at the southeast of the Imperial City a palace for the imperial great-grandson was built; southeast outside East Peace Gate, Ten Princes Street was built.
translations.idiomatic: Again at the southeast of the Imperial City a palace for the imperial great-grandson was built, and southeast outside the East Peace Gate the Ten Princes Street was laid out.

sentences.zh: 宣宗留意文雅，建廣寒、清暑二殿，及東、西瓊島，遊觀所至，悉置經籍。

translations.literal: The Xuande Emperor attended to literary elegance, building Broad Cold and Clear Summer halls and east and west Jade Isles; wherever he toured, he placed classics and records.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuande Emperor valued literary refinement, building the Broad Cold and Clear Summer halls and the eastern and western Jade Isles; wherever he traveled for pleasure, he placed classics and records.

sentences.zh: 正統六年重建三殿。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhengtong, the three main halls were rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Zhengtong, the three main halls were rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖中，於清甯宮後地建慈慶宮，於仁壽宮故基建慈甯宮。

translations.literal: In the Jiajing reign, on ground behind Palace of Pure Tranquility Ciji Palace was built; on the old site of Palace of Benevolent Longevity, Cining Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiajing reign, on land behind the Palace of Pure Tranquility the Ciji Palace was built, and on the former site of the Palace of Benevolent Longevity the Cining Palace was built.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，三殿門樓災，帝以殿名奉天，非題扁所宜用，敕禮部議之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, fire damaged the three halls and their gate-towers; the emperor held that because the hall was named Complying with Heaven, it was unsuitable as an inscribed plaque title, and ordered the Ministry of Rites to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year, fire destroyed the three halls and their gate-towers; the emperor held that because the hall was named Complying with Heaven, it was unsuitable as an inscribed plaque title and ordered the Ministry of Rites to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 部臣會議言：「皇祖肇造之初，名曰奉天者，昭揭以示虔爾。

translations.literal: Ministry officials met and said: "When our imperial ancestor first founded the realm, naming it Complying with Heaven proclaimed reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry officials met and reported: "When our imperial ancestor first founded the realm, naming it Complying with Heaven proclaimed reverence.

sentences.zh: 既以名，則是昊天監臨，儼然在上，臨御之際，坐以視朝，似未安也。

translations.literal: Once so named, Heaven above watches and presides; when the emperor sits there to hold court, it seems not altogether fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Once so named, the August Heaven above watches and presides; when the emperor sits there to hold court, it seems not altogether fitting.

sentences.zh: 今乃修復之始，宜更定，以答天庥。

translations.literal: Now at the beginning of repair, names should be changed anew, to answer Heaven's favor.
translations.idiomatic: Now at the beginning of restoration, the names should be changed anew to answer Heaven's favor."

sentences.zh: 」明年重建奉天門，更名曰大朝門。

translations.literal: " The next year Gate of Complying with Heaven was rebuilt and renamed Great Audience Gate.
translations.idiomatic: " The following year the Gate of Complying with Heaven was rebuilt and renamed the Great Audience Gate.

sentences.zh: 四十一年更名奉天殿曰皇極，華蓋殿曰中極，謹身殿曰建極，文樓曰文昭閣，武樓曰武成閣，左順門曰會極，右順門曰歸極，大朝門曰皇極，東角門曰弘政，西角門曰宣治。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year Hall of Complying with Heaven was renamed Supreme Ultimate; Hall of Imperial Canopy, Central Ultimate; Hall of Cultivating the Person, Establishing Ultimate; Literary Tower, Literary Brilliance Pavilion; Martial Tower, Martial Accomplishment Pavilion; Left Following Gate, Gathering Ultimate; Right Following Gate, Returning Ultimate; Great Audience Gate, Supreme Ultimate; East Corner Gate, Extending Governance; West Corner Gate, Proclaiming Order.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year the Hall of Complying with Heaven was renamed Supreme Ultimate; the Hall of the Imperial Canopy, Central Ultimate; the Hall of Cultivating the Person, Establishing Ultimate; the Literary Tower, Literary Brilliance Pavilion; the Martial Tower, Martial Accomplishment Pavilion; the Left Following Gate, Gathering Ultimate; the Right Following Gate, Returning Ultimate; the Great Audience Gate, Supreme Ultimate; the East Corner Gate, Extending Governance; and the West Corner Gate, Proclaiming Order.

sentences.zh: 又改乾清宮右小閣名曰道心，旁左門曰仁蕩，右門曰義平。

translations.literal: Also the small pavilion to the right of Palace of Celestial Purity was named Path of the Heart; the gate to its left, Benevolence Expansive; to the right, Righteousness Level.
translations.idiomatic: The small pavilion to the right of the Palace of Celestial Purity was also renamed Path of the Heart; the gate to its left, Benevolence Expansive; to the right, Righteousness Level.

sentences.zh: 世宗初，墾西苑隙地為田，建殿曰無逸，亭曰豳風，又建亭曰省耕，曰省斂，每歲耕獲，帝輒臨觀。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Shizong reign, spare land in the Western Park was reclaimed as fields; a hall called No Idleness was built, a pavilion called Odes of Bin, and pavilions called Inspecting the Plough and Inspecting the Harvest; each year at ploughing and harvest the emperor would personally go to observe.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Shizong reign, spare land in the Western Park was reclaimed as fields; a hall called No Idleness was built, a pavilion called Odes of Bin, and pavilions called Inspecting the Plough and Inspecting the Harvest; each year at ploughing and harvest the emperor would personally go to observe.

sentences.zh: 十三年，西苑河東亭榭成，親定名曰天鵝房，北曰飛靄亭，迎翠殿前曰浮香亭，寶月亭前曰秋輝亭，昭和殿前曰澄淵亭，後曰 ＡＺ臺坡，臨漪亭前曰水雲榭，西苑門外二亭曰左臨海亭、右臨海亭，北閘口曰湧玉亭，河之東曰聚景亭，改呂樑洪之亭曰呂樑，前曰檥金亭，翠玉館前曰擷秀亭。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, pavilions and terraces east of the river in the Western Park were completed; the emperor personally fixed names: Swans Lodge; north, Flying Mist Pavilion; before Welcoming Green Hall, Floating Fragrance Pavilion; before Precious Moon Pavilion, Autumn Radiance Pavilion; before Zhaohua Hall, Clear Abyss Pavilion; behind, Yutai Terrace Slope (source text reads ＡＺ臺坡); before Rippling Waters Pavilion, Water and Clouds Veranda; outside Western Park gate, two pavilions Left Overlooking-the-Sea and Right Overlooking-the-Sea; at the north sluice, Jade-Emerging Pavilion; east of the river, Gathering Scenery Pavilion; Lüliang Hong's pavilion was renamed Lüliang; before it, Mooring Gold Pavilion; before Emerald Jade Lodge, Gathering Excellence Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, the pavilions and terraces east of the river in the Western Park were completed; the emperor personally fixed their names: the Swans Lodge; to the north, the Flying Mist Pavilion; before the Welcoming Green Hall, the Floating Fragrance Pavilion; before the Precious Moon Pavilion, the Autumn Radiance Pavilion; before the Zhaohua Hall, the Clear Abyss Pavilion; behind it, the Yutai Terrace Slope; before the Rippling Waters Pavilion, the Water and Clouds Veranda; outside the Western Park gate, the Left Overlooking-the-Sea and Right Overlooking-the-Sea pavilions; at the north sluice, the Jade-Emerging Pavilion; east of the river, the Gathering Scenery Pavilion; Lüliang Hong's pavilion was renamed Lüliang; before it, the Mooring Gold Pavilion; and before the Emerald Jade Lodge, the Gathering Excellence Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 親王府制：洪武四年定，城高二丈九尺，正殿基高六尺九寸，正門、前後殿、四門城樓，飾以青綠點金，廊房飾以青黛。

translations.literal: Princely residence regulations: fixed in the fourth year of Hongwu—the city wall twenty-nine feet high, main hall platform six feet nine inches high, main gate, front and rear halls, four gate-towers, decorated in green with gold points; corridor rooms in blue-black.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations for princely residences were fixed in the fourth year of Hongwu: the city wall was twenty-nine feet high, the main hall platform six feet nine inches high; the main gate, front and rear halls, and four gate-towers were decorated in green with gold points, and corridor rooms in blue-black.

sentences.zh: 四城正門，以丹漆，金塗銅釘。

translations.literal: The four city's main gates used cinnabar lacquer with gold-coated bronze nails.
translations.idiomatic: The four main gates of the city were finished in cinnabar lacquer with gold-coated bronze nails.

sentences.zh: 宮殿窠栱攢頂，中畫蟠螭，飾以金，邊畫八吉祥花。

translations.literal: Palace halls with bracket sets and clustered ridge-ends, center painted with coiled dragons, ornamented in gold, border painted with the eight auspicious emblems.
translations.idiomatic: Palace halls had bracket sets and clustered ridge-ends; the center was painted with coiled dragons ornamented in gold, and the border with the eight auspicious emblems.

sentences.zh: 前後殿座，用紅漆金蟠螭，帳用紅銷金蟠螭。

translations.literal: Front and rear hall seats used red lacquer with gold coiled dragons; curtains used red brocade with gold coiled dragons.
translations.idiomatic: The front and rear hall seats used red lacquer with gold coiled dragons; curtains used red brocade with gold coiled dragons.

sentences.zh: 座後壁則畫蟠螭、彩雲，後改為龍。

translations.literal: The wall behind the seat painted coiled dragons and colored clouds—later changed to dragons.
translations.idiomatic: The wall behind the seat was painted with coiled dragons and colored clouds—later changed to dragons.

sentences.zh: 立山川、社稷、宗廟於王城內。

translations.literal: Altars to mountains and rivers, soil and grain, and the ancestral temple were erected within the princely city.
translations.idiomatic: Altars to the mountains and rivers, soil and grain, and the ancestral temple were established within the princely city.

sentences.zh: 七年定親王所居殿，前曰承運，中曰圜殿，後曰存心；

translations.literal: In the seventh year the halls where princes dwelt were fixed: front called Receiving the Mandate; center, Round Hall; rear, Preserving the Heart;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the halls where princes resided were fixed: the front hall called Receiving the Mandate; the center, the Round Hall; the rear, Preserving the Heart;

sentences.zh: 四城門，南曰端禮，北曰廣智，東曰體仁，西曰遵義。

translations.literal: the four city gates: south, Correct Ritual; north, Broad Wisdom; east, Embodying Humanity; west, Following Righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: the four city gates were: to the south, Correct Ritual; to the north, Broad Wisdom; to the east, Embodying Humanity; to the west, Following Righteousness.

sentences.zh: 太祖曰：「使諸王睹名思義，以籓屏帝室。

translations.literal: The Founder said: "Let the various princes see the names and think of their meanings, to be a screen wall for the imperial house."
translations.idiomatic: The Founder said: "Let the various princes see the names and reflect on their meanings, to serve as a protective screen for the imperial house."

sentences.zh: 」九年定親王宮殿、門廡及城門樓，皆覆以青色琉璃瓦。

translations.literal: In the ninth year princely palace buildings, side galleries, and gate-towers were all roofed with blue glazed tiles.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, princely palace buildings, side galleries, and gate-towers were all roofed with blue glazed tiles.

sentences.zh: 又命中書省臣，惟親王宮得飾硃紅、大青綠，其他居室止飾丹碧。

translations.literal: Also he ordered Ministry of Personnel officials: only princely palaces might use vermilion red and great green; other dwellings might use only cinnabar and jade-green.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered officials of the Secretariat: only princely palaces might use vermilion red and great green; other residences were limited to cinnabar and jade-green.

sentences.zh: 十二年，諸王府告成。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, all princely residences were completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, all princely residences were completed.

sentences.zh: 其制，中曰承運殿，十一間，後為圜殿，次曰存心殿，各九間。

translations.literal: The layout: center, Hall of Receiving the Mandate, eleven bays; behind, Round Hall; next, Hall of Preserving the Heart—each nine bays.
translations.idiomatic: The layout was: at the center, the Hall of Receiving the Mandate of eleven bays; behind it, the Round Hall; next, the Hall of Preserving the Heart—each of nine bays.

sentences.zh: 承運殿兩廡為左右二殿，自存心、承運，週迴兩廡，至承運門，為屋百三十八間。

translations.literal: The two side halls beside Hall of Receiving the Mandate were left and right halls; from Preserving the Heart and Receiving the Mandate, galleries ran all around to Gate of Receiving the Mandate—138 bay-rooms.
translations.idiomatic: The two side halls flanking the Hall of Receiving the Mandate were the left and right halls; from the Preserving the Heart and Receiving the Mandate halls, galleries ran all around to the Gate of Receiving the Mandate—138 bay-rooms in all.

sentences.zh: 殿後為前、中、後三宮，各九間。

translations.literal: Behind the halls were front, central, and rear three palaces, each nine bays.
translations.idiomatic: Behind the halls were front, central, and rear palaces of three sections, each nine bays.

sentences.zh: 宮門兩廂等室九十九間。

translations.literal: Palace gate side chambers and like rooms totaled ninety-nine bays.
translations.idiomatic: Side chambers flanking the palace gates and similar rooms totaled ninety-nine bays.

sentences.zh: 王城之外，周垣、西門、堂庫等室在其間，凡為宮殿室屋八百間有奇。

translations.literal: Outside the princely city, encircling walls, west gate, hall-storehouses and such lay between—altogether more than eight hundred palace chambers and rooms.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the princely city, encircling walls, the west gate, halls, storehouses, and the like lay between—altogether more than eight hundred palace chambers and rooms.

sentences.zh: 弘治八年更定王府之制，頗有所增損。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Hongzhi the princely residence system was revised again, with considerable additions and reductions.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Hongzhi the regulations for princely residences were revised again, with considerable additions and reductions.

sentences.zh: 郡王府制：天順四年定。

translations.literal: Commandery prince residence system: fixed in the fourth year of Tianshun.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations for commandery-prince residences were fixed in the fourth year of Tianshun.

sentences.zh: 門樓、廳廂、廚庫、米倉等，共數十間而已。

translations.literal: Gate-towers, halls, side chambers, kitchens, granaries, and the like amounted to only several dozen rooms.
translations.idiomatic: Gate-towers, halls, side chambers, kitchens, granaries, and the like amounted to only several dozen rooms.

sentences.zh: 公主府第：洪武五年，禮部言：「唐、宋公主視正一品，府第並用正一品制度。

translations.literal: Princess residences: In the fifth year of Hongwu, the Ministry of Rites said: "Tang and Song princesses were treated as Grade 1 Positive; residences used Grade 1 Positive regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Princess residences: In the fifth year of Hongwu, the Ministry of Rites reported: "Under the Tang and Song, princesses were treated as Grade 1 Positive, and their residences followed Grade 1 Positive regulations.

sentences.zh: 今擬公主第，廳堂九間，十一架，施花樣獸脊，樑、棟、鬥栱、簷桷彩色繪飾，惟不用金。

translations.literal: It is now proposed for princess residences: reception hall nine bays, eleven bracket tiers, with patterned-animal ridge; beams, pillars, bracket arms, and eaves painted in colors, but without gold.
translations.idiomatic: It is now proposed for princess residences: the reception hall shall have nine bays and eleven bracket tiers, with a patterned-animal ridge; beams, pillars, bracket arms, and eaves shall be painted in colors, but without gold.

sentences.zh: 正門五間，七架。

translations.literal: Main gate five bays, seven tiers.
translations.idiomatic: The main gate shall have five bays and seven tiers.

sentences.zh: 大門，綠油，銅環。

translations.literal: Great gate with green oil, bronze rings.
translations.idiomatic: The great gate shall be finished in green oil with bronze rings.

sentences.zh: 石礎、牆磚，鐫鑿玲瓏花樣。

translations.literal: Stone foundations and wall bricks carved with delicate openwork patterns.
translations.idiomatic: Stone foundations and wall bricks shall be carved with delicate openwork patterns.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 百官第宅：明初，禁官民房屋不許雕刻古帝后、聖賢人物及日月、龍鳳、狻猊、麒麟、犀象之形。

translations.literal: Official and commoner dwellings: At the beginning of Ming, carving of ancient emperors and empresses, sages and worthies, and forms of sun, moon, dragon, phoenix, suanni, qilin, rhinoceros, and elephant was forbidden on houses.
translations.idiomatic: Dwellings of officials and commoners: At the beginning of the Ming, it was forbidden to carve on houses images of ancient emperors and empresses, sages and worthies, or of the sun, moon, dragon, phoenix, suanni, qilin, rhinoceros, and elephant.

sentences.zh: 凡官員任滿致仕，與見任同。

translations.literal: Officials who had completed their term and retired received the same treatment as incumbents.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who had completed their term and retired were subject to the same regulations as those still in office.

sentences.zh: 其父祖有官，身歿，子孫許居父祖房舍。

translations.literal: If their father or grandfather had held office and died, descendants were permitted to dwell in the father's or grandfather's house.
translations.idiomatic: If their father or grandfather had held office and died, descendants were permitted to reside in the father's or grandfather's dwelling.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十六年定制，官員營造房屋，不許歇山轉角，重簷重栱，及繪藻井，惟樓居重簷不禁。

translations.literal: Regulations fixed in Hongwu 26: officials constructing houses might not use hip-and-gable roofs with corner turns, double eaves, double bracket sets, or painted well-canopies—only upper-story buildings with double eaves were not forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations fixed in the twenty-sixth year of Hongwu: when officials built houses, they might not use hip-and-gable roofs with corner turns, double eaves, double bracket sets, or painted well-canopies—only upper-story buildings with double eaves were not forbidden.

sentences.zh: 公侯，前廳七間、兩廈，九架。

translations.literal: Dukes and marquises: front hall seven bays with two wings, nine tiers.
translations.idiomatic: Dukes and marquises: the front hall had seven bays with two wings and nine bracket tiers.

sentences.zh: 中堂七間，九架。

translations.literal: Central hall seven bays, nine tiers.
translations.idiomatic: The central hall had seven bays and nine bracket tiers.

sentences.zh: 後堂七間，七架。

translations.literal: Rear hall seven bays, seven bracket tiers.
translations.idiomatic: The rear hall had seven bays and seven bracket tiers.

sentences.zh: 門三間，五架，用金漆及獸面錫環。

translations.literal: Gate three bays, five tiers, with gold lacquer and beast-face tin rings.
translations.idiomatic: The gate had three bays and five bracket tiers, finished in gold lacquer with beast-face tin rings.

sentences.zh: 家廟三間，五架。

translations.literal: Family temple three bays, five tiers.
translations.idiomatic: The family temple had three bays and five bracket tiers.

sentences.zh: 覆以黑板瓦，脊用花樣瓦獸，樑、棟、鬥栱、簷桷彩繪飾。

translations.literal: Roofed with black-board tiles; ridge with patterned tile beasts; beams, pillars, bracket arms, and eaves painted in colors.
translations.idiomatic: The roof used black-board tiles, the ridge bore patterned tile beasts, and the beams, pillars, bracket arms, and eaves were painted in colors.

sentences.zh: 門窗、枋柱金漆飾。

translations.literal: Doors, windows, and frame pillars ornamented with gold lacquer.
translations.idiomatic: Doors, windows, and frame pillars were ornamented with gold lacquer.

sentences.zh: 廊、廡、庖、庫從屋，不得過五間，七架。

translations.literal: Corridors, side halls, kitchens, storehouses, and dependent buildings might not exceed five bays or seven tiers.
translations.idiomatic: Corridors, side halls, kitchens, storehouses, and dependent buildings might not exceed five bays or seven bracket tiers.

sentences.zh: 一品、二品，廳堂五間，九架，屋脊用瓦獸，樑、棟、鬥栱、簷桷青碧繪飾。

translations.literal: Rank 1a and 1b: reception hall five bays, nine tiers, ridge with tile beasts; beams, pillars, bracket arms, and eaves painted in green-blue.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 1a and 1b officials: reception hall of five bays and nine bracket tiers, ridge with tile beasts, beams, pillars, bracket arms, and eaves painted in green-blue.

sentences.zh: 門三間，五架，綠油，獸面錫環。

translations.literal: Gate three bays, five tiers, green oil finish, beast-face tin rings.
translations.idiomatic: The gate had three bays and five bracket tiers, a green oil finish, and beast-face tin rings.

sentences.zh: 三品至五品，廳堂五間，七架，屋脊用瓦獸，樑、棟、簷桷青碧繪飾。

translations.literal: Rank 3a through 5b: reception hall five bays, seven tiers, ridge with tile beasts; beams, pillars, and eaves painted in green-blue.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 3a through 5b officials: reception hall of five bays and seven bracket tiers, ridge with tile beasts, beams, pillars, and eaves painted in green-blue.

sentences.zh: 門三間，三架，黑油，錫環。

translations.literal: Gate three bays, three tiers, black oil finish, tin rings.
translations.idiomatic: The gate had three bays and three bracket tiers, a black oil finish, and tin rings.

sentences.zh: 六品至九品，廳堂三間，七架，樑、棟飾以土黃。

translations.literal: Rank 6a through 9b: reception hall three bays, seven tiers; beams and pillars ornamented in ochre yellow.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 6a through 9b officials: reception hall of three bays and seven bracket tiers, with beams and pillars ornamented in ochre yellow.

sentences.zh: 門一間，三架，黑門，鐵環。

translations.literal: Gate one bay, three tiers, black door, iron rings.
translations.idiomatic: The gate had one bay and three bracket tiers, a black door, and iron rings.

sentences.zh: 品官房舍，門窗、戶牖不得用丹漆。

translations.literal: Ranked officials' houses: doors, windows, and lattices might not use cinnabar lacquer.
translations.idiomatic: In the houses of ranked officials, doors, windows, and lattices might not use cinnabar lacquer.

sentences.zh: 功臣宅舍之後，留空地十丈，左右皆五丈。

translations.literal: Behind the dwellings of meritorious officials, ten zhang of open ground was left; five zhang on left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Behind the dwellings of meritorious officials, ten zhang of open ground was reserved, with five zhang on each side.

sentences.zh: 不許那移軍民居止，更不許於宅前後左右多佔地，構亭館，開池塘，以資遊眺。

translations.literal: It was forbidden to displace military households for residence, and still more forbidden to seize extra land before, behind, left, or right of the dwelling to build pavilions or halls, open ponds, and provide for scenic viewing.
translations.idiomatic: It was forbidden to displace military households for residence, and still more forbidden to seize extra land around the dwelling to build pavilions, open ponds, and create scenic retreats.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，申明禁制，一品、三品廳堂各七間，六品至九品廳堂樑棟祗用粉青飾之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year, prohibitions were restated: rank 1a and 3a reception halls each seven bays; rank 6a through 9b reception-hall beams and pillars used only powder-blue ornament.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year, prohibitions were restated: rank 1a and 3a reception halls were limited to seven bays each, and rank 6a through 9b reception-hall beams and pillars might use only powder-blue ornament.

sentences.zh: 庶民廬舍：洪武二十六年定制，不過三間，五架，不許用鬥栱，飾彩色。

translations.literal: Commoners' cottages: fixed in Hongwu 26, not exceeding three bays or five tiers; bracket arms and colored ornament were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners' cottages: regulations fixed in Hongwu 26 limited them to no more than three bays and five bracket tiers, and forbade bracket arms and colored ornament.

sentences.zh: 三十五年復申禁飭，不許造九五間數，房屋雖至一二十所，隨基物力，但不許過三間。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year prohibitions were again enforced: the nine-five bay count was forbidden; though houses might reach a dozen or twenty structures according to the foundation's means, none might exceed three bays.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year prohibitions were enforced again: the nine-five bay pattern was forbidden; though a household might build a dozen or twenty structures according to its means, none might exceed three bays.

sentences.zh: 正統十二年令稍變通之，庶民房屋架多而間少者，不在禁限。

translations.literal: In Zhengtong 12 (1447) a slight relaxation was ordered: commoners' houses with many tiers but few bays were not within the prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 12 (1447) a slight relaxation was ordered: commoners' houses with many bracket tiers but few bays were not subject to the prohibition.

sentences.zh: 器用之禁：洪武二十六年定，公侯、一品、二品，酒注、酒盞金，餘用銀。

translations.literal: Prohibitions on utensils: fixed in Hongwu 26—dukes, marquises, rank 1a and 1b used gold for wine ewers and cups; the rest silver.
translations.idiomatic: Prohibitions on utensils: fixed in Hongwu 26—dukes, marquises, and rank 1a and 1b officials used gold for wine ewers and cups, silver for other vessels.

sentences.zh: 三品至五品，酒注銀，酒盞金，六品至九品，酒注、酒盞銀，餘皆磁、漆。

translations.literal: Rank 3a through 5b: ewers silver, cups gold; rank 6a through 9b: ewers and cups silver; all else porcelain or lacquer.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 3a through 5b officials used silver ewers and gold cups; rank 6a through 9b used silver ewers and cups; all other vessels were porcelain or lacquer.

sentences.zh: 木器不許用硃紅及抹金、描金、雕琢龍鳳文。

translations.literal: Wooden utensils might not use cinnabar red, applied gold, traced gold, or carved dragon-and-phoenix designs.
translations.idiomatic: Wooden utensils might not use cinnabar red, applied gold, traced gold, or carved dragon-and-phoenix designs.

sentences.zh: 庶民，酒注錫，酒盞銀，餘用磁、漆。

translations.literal: Commoners: ewers tin, cups silver; the rest porcelain or lacquer.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners used tin ewers and silver cups; other vessels were porcelain or lacquer.

sentences.zh: 百官，牀面、屏風、槅子，雜色漆飾，不許雕刻龍文，並金飾硃漆。

translations.literal: All officials: bed surfaces, screens, and lattice panels with varicolored lacquer ornament—carving dragon designs and gold ornament on cinnabar lacquer were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: For all officials, bed surfaces, screens, and lattice panels might use varicolored lacquer ornament, but carving dragon designs and applying gold on cinnabar lacquer were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 軍官、軍士，弓矢黑漆，弓袋、箭囊，不許用硃漆描金裝飾。

translations.literal: Military officers and soldiers: bows and arrows black-lacquered; bow cases and quivers might not use cinnabar lacquer or traced-gold ornament.
translations.idiomatic: Military officers and soldiers lacquered bows and arrows in black; bow cases and quivers might not use cinnabar lacquer or traced-gold ornament.

sentences.zh: 建文四年申飭官民，不許僭用金酒爵，其椅棹木器亦不許硃紅金飾。

translations.literal: In Jianwen 4 (1402) officials and commoners were admonished: usurpation of gold wine vessels was forbidden; chairs, tables, and wooden utensils likewise might not use cinnabar red or gold ornament.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianwen 4 (1402) officials and commoners were admonished: usurpation of gold wine vessels was forbidden, and chairs, tables, and wooden utensils likewise might not use cinnabar red or gold ornament.

sentences.zh: 正德十六年定，一品、二品，器皿不用玉，止許用金。

translations.literal: Fixed in Zhengde 16 (1521): rank 1a and 1b might not use jade utensils, only gold permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Fixed in Zhengde 16 (1521): rank 1a and 1b officials might not use jade utensils and were permitted only gold.

sentences.zh: 商賈、技藝家器皿不許用銀。

translations.literal: Merchants and artisans might not use silver utensils.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants and artisans might not use silver utensils.

sentences.zh: 餘與庶民同。

translations.literal: All else was the same as for commoners.
translations.idiomatic: All other regulations were the same as for commoners.
